Tonight, on Georges' coding livestream (starting momentarily), he will attempt to port GNOME Calendar's "GcalCalendarMonitor" to libdex! Tune in here: https://www.youtube.com/live/xNIyG-dccE0

You can learn more about @chergert@my.devsuite.app's libdex through the various blog posts mentioned here: https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libdex/-/blob/main/README.md#more-information as well as https://blogs.gnome.org/chergert/2025/09/01/libdex-1-0/
